metadata.description: Offline Planar Kinematic Characterization Audit (a_y ≈ v_x * w_z)

phase_f_heading_observability.mathematical_conclusion: Kinematic residual r_kin = a_y - v_x * w_z exhibits purely SECOND-ORDER sensitivity to heading error: d(r_kin)/d(psi)|_0 = 0. At 5 deg heading error during turns, the signal is only 0.0038 m/s^2, submerged under smartphone noise (2.38 m/s^2) at SNR = -66.0 dB. Thus, r_kin provides ZERO first-order heading observability in an ESKF.
